gate: WF-022 pilot-ready gate 1 — the real Taipei trip planned end to end in the webapp
verdict: met in substance, thin in content

walking_cap.note: a genuine cap, one rung looser than the 20/45 it replaced

dropped_as_closed: Herbarium of Taipei Botanical Garden (closed 2026-12-29 and 2027-01-04)

paid.estimate_error: preflighted google_places:details at US$0.017; refresh_opening_hours actually bills google_places:search_text at US$0.025, so US$0.085 estimated against US$0.125 spent

what_the_paid_call_bought: the activated plan had scheduled Red House and the Herbarium on 2027-01-04, the one day both are closed. Real opening hours moved or dropped them.
why_only_three_visits: 5 candidate places cannot fill 7 days. With 41 places the optimizer spread 20 visits across 8 days, so this is not a packing defect — it is the downstream effect of WF-038: no transit means the walking cap admits only two adjacent districts, which admits only five landmarks.
defects_fixed_along_the_way: MAX_ROUTE_REQUESTS capped total coverage rather than per-run
route pairs were fetched in place_id order rather than nearest-first
a whole-trip walking total was compared against a per-day budget
